gloss: to help; to lend a hand

definitions.gloss: to help; to assist; to lend a hand
definitions.explanation: To provide practical assistance to someone who needs it. Implies hands-on, direct help rather than abstract support.

examples.japanese: {引|ひ}っ{越|こ}し⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{手助|てだす}けする。
⟦{困|こま}っている→困る：00861_komaru⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{手助|てだす}けしたい。
examples.english: I want to help people who are in trouble.

examples.japanese: ⟦{近所|きんじょ}→近所：01318_kinjo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧たち⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{復旧|ふっきゅう}→復旧：07521_fukkyuu⟧⟦{作業|さぎょう}→作業：02775_sagyou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{手助|てだす}けして⟦くれた→くれる：00724_kureru⟧。
examples.english: The neighbors helped with the restoration work.

notes:
Formed from ⟦{手|て}→手：00569_te⟧ (hand) + ⟦{助|たす}け→助け：07777_tasuke⟧ (help), conveying the image of literally lending a hand. More concrete and action-oriented than abstract forms of assistance.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{手助|てだす}け→手助け：12769_tedasuke⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to lend a hand (with ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧ particle variant)
- ⟦{手助|てだす}け→手助け：12769_tedasuke⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{必要|ひつよう}→必要：00846_hitsuyou⟧: to need help
- ⟦{手助|てだす}け→手助け：12769_tedasuke⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{求|もと}める→求める：02316_motomeru⟧: to seek help
- ⟦ちょっとした→ちょっとした：27439_chottoshita⟧⟦{手助|てだす}け→手助け：12769_tedasuke⟧: a little bit of help

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{手伝|てつだ}う→手伝う：00898_tetsudau⟧: to help — the most common everyday word for helping
- ⟦{助|たす}ける→助ける：00895_tasukeru⟧: to save; to rescue — implies someone is in danger or serious difficulty
- ⟦{援助|えんじょ}する→援助する：26855_enjosuru⟧: to provide aid — formal; often used for institutional or international assistance
- ⟦サポート→サポート：07776_sapooto⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to support — loanword; often used in business and technology contexts
